integrity: General proof is the exact orbit-barycenter/cyclic-gap identification; standalone exhaustive finite tests independently check face equivalences and residual actions. The finite checks alone do not prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only finite regularly spaced circular Čech nerves, closed intervals, nontrivial rotational subgroups, integer scales. Ordinary homotopy classification is from cited source, independent audit not done. Unindexed equivalent literature possible.
title: Cyclic fixed-point persistence of evenly spaced circular Čech nerves
